subject.title: [Bug]: /context detail shows ~62k untracked provider/runtime overhead on fresh OpenAI Codex gpt-5.5 session

question: Which Codex/provider usage buckets should `/context detail` treat as context-window occupancy versus billing/cache/native runtime overhead?
rationale: The code can expose more buckets, but the permanent labels and any compaction/status semantics depend on provider contract interpretation and maintainer UX policy.

options.title: Design provider-aware ledger
options.body: Keep #86819 open and implement a confidence-tagged ledger after live Codex proof confirms each bucket's meaning.

options.title: Limit to wording only
options.body: Rename the residual to a clearer unknown bucket without changing status or compaction semantics.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a current-main Codex OAuth run reproduces the residual with raw token payload evidence.

recommendation.title: Design provider-aware ledger
recommendation.body: Keep #86819 open and implement a confidence-tagged ledger after live Codex proof confirms each bucket's meaning.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans session usage accounting, Codex provider routing, and product-level context diagnostics, where history shows broad adjacent ownership.
